item.description:
Portside now has its trial and license aboard — and this update is the
first one delivered by the app itself.

### What's new

- A 7-day free trial with the full app, starting at first launch. The
  Portside menu carries the honest countdown ("Trial: 5 days left"), and
  when the trial ends the app locks — cleanly, with Buy and Sign In as
  the doors — while everything you had open waits underneath and comes
  back untouched the moment you sign in.
- Sign in with the email and password from your purchase and this Mac is
  licensed. One license is active on one Mac at a time: signing in on a
  new Mac moves it, and the old one says exactly that — never "your
  trial has ended" to someone who already paid, and never a Buy button
  on a Mac that's already licensed.
- Portside is a one-window app now: no stray ⌘N windows, and closing
  the window keeps the app running — the Window menu brings it back
  exactly as you left it.
- A record carried to a new Mac by Migration Assistant or a backup
  restore asks for a sign-in there instead of quietly counting as a
  second licensed Mac.

### Known limitations

- The license check-in needs the network once a week; 14 days offline
  locks the app until one check-in succeeds.
